# brightplace Operator Pages
> Apartment community pages with all-in pricing, floor plans, amenities, and neighborhood data. Every price includes required monthly fees — no hidden costs.

## Air Communities
- [Oak Trail at Cherry Creek South](/air-communities/oak-trail): Modern Denver apartments near Cherry Creek State Park. 7 floor plans from $1,512/mo all-in. Two resort pools, 24hr fitness, dog park. 2234 S Trenton Way, Denver CO 80231.

## Towne Properties
- [Harpers Point](/towne-properties/harpers-point): Resort-style Cincinnati apartments with white sand beach, full-service pub, and award-winning landscaping. 8 floor plans from $1,285/mo. 8713 Harperpoint Drive, Cincinnati OH 45249.

## Stories & Guides
- [Oak Trail Cherry Creek Guide](/air-communities/oak-trail-cherry-creek-guide): Complete guide to Oak Trail apartments, all-in pricing, Cherry Creek State Park access, floor plans from $1,512/mo.
- [Harpers Point Resort Guide](/towne-properties/harpers-point-resort-guide): Harpers Point Cincinnati guide with white sand beach, full-service pub, 8 floor plans from $1,285/mo.

## About brightplace
brightplace provides transparent apartment information with all-in pricing. No hidden fees. Every price includes required monthly costs like water, sewer, trash, and pest control. Utilities you control (electricity, internet) are billed separately by your provider.
